title: Polynomial graph-partition conjecture for bounded-VC$_2$ hypergraphs
statement:
Assume for simplicity that $\mathcal{H}$ is tripartite with parts $X,Y,Z$, each of size $n$. An **$\varepsilon$-graph partition** consists of partitions

$$
X\times Y=E_1\sqcup\dots\sqcup E_M,\quad X\times Z=F_1\sqcup\dots\sqcup F_M,\quad Y\times Z=G_1\sqcup\dots\sqcup G_M,
$$

and a function $f:[M]^3\to\{0,1\}$ such that for all but $\varepsilon n^3$ triples $(x,y,z)\in X\times Y\times Z$, if $xy\in E_i$, $xz\in F_j$, and $yz\in G_k$, then

$$
xyz\in E(\mathcal{H})\Longleftrightarrow f(i,j,k)=1.
$$

**Polynomial graph-partition conjecture.** If $\mathcal{H}$ has bounded VC$_2$ dimension, then it has an $\varepsilon$-graph partition with $M=\operatorname{poly}(1/\varepsilon)$ many graphs. This would sharpen the tower-type bound currently obtained for such graph partitions; polynomial bounds remain open.
source_name: Lior Gishboliner, Asaf Shapira and Yuval Wigderson, “Regularity for hypergraphs with bounded VC_2 dimension”, arXiv:2508.09969 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.09969

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2025).
